column1: AN  ACT  TO  AUTHORISE  THE  RAISING  OF  LOANS  IN  OR  OUTSIDE

column2: SRI LANKA FOR THE PURPOSE OF ACTIVE LIABILITY MANAGEMENT
TO IMPROVE PUBLIC DEBT MANAGEMENT  IN SRI LANKA AND TO
MAKE  PROVISIONS  FOR  MATTERS  CONNECTED  THEREWITH  OR

column1: INCIDENTAL THERETO.
BE it  enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:—

column2: This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Active  Liability

column1: Management Act, No. 8 of 2018 and shall come in to operation
on such date as the Minister may appoint by Order published
in the Gazette.

column2: The objective of this Act shall be to manage public

column1: debt to ensure the financing needs and payment obligations
of the Government are met at the lowest possible cost over
the medium to long term consistent with a prudent degree
of risk.

column2: The Parliament may, during a particular financial year

column1: from time to time, by resolution, approve to raise sums of
money, the total of which shall not exceed ten percentum of
the  total  outstanding  debt  as  at  the  end  of  the  preceding
financial year, as a loan  whether in or outside Sri Lanka, in
terms of the relevant laws for moneys to be raised including
the provisions of the Monetary Law Act (Chapter 422), the
Local  Treasury  Bills  Ordinance  (Chapter  417),  Registered
Stocks and Securities Ordinance (Chapter 420), or the Foreign
Loans Act, No. 29 of 1957, for and on behalf of the Government
for the purposes of refinancing and pre-financing of public
debts of the Government.
